description: Source code for the SQL store implementation of draft management in Mattermost, including CRUD operations, size determination, and cleanup functions.

classes.name: SqlDraftStore
classes.description: Implementation of the DraftStore interface for SQL database operations related to drafts.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a draft for a specific user, channel, and root ID, optionally including deleted drafts.

methods.name: Upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a draft in the database.

methods.name: GetDraftsForUser
methods.description: Fetches all drafts for a specific user, optionally filtered by team ID.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific draft based on user, channel, and root ID.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteByUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes all drafts associated with a user.

methods.name: DeleteDraftsAssociatedWithPost
methods.description: Deletes all drafts linked to a specific post (channel and root ID).

methods.name: GetMaxDraftSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size (in runes) allowed for draft messages.

methods.name: determineMaxDraftSize
methods.description: Determines the maximum draft size based on database schema information.

methods.name: GetLastCreateAtAndUserIdValuesForEmptyDraftsMigration
methods.description: Retrieves the last creation timestamp and user ID for migrating empty drafts.

methods.name: DeleteEmptyDraftsByCreateAtAndUserId
methods.description: Deletes empty drafts created at or after a specific timestamp for a user.

methods.name: DeleteOrphanDraftsByCreateAtAndUserId
methods.description: Deletes orphan drafts associated with deleted posts or with no existing post.
